extracted.intended_audience: applicants (and their patent agents/attorneys) filing PCT international-phase patent applications; receiving office and IPEA staff
extracted.subtask_description: Official guidance and index entries covering the form, content, procedural requirements and substantive patentability standards applicable to PCT international-phase applications (including search and preliminary examination).

rubrics_metrics.name: Novelty (for purposes of IPE)
rubrics_metrics.description: Novelty — defined (for purposes of IPE); one of IPE criteria.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Declaration as to exceptions to lack of novelty; lack of novelty may be the subject of comment in the written opinion; relevant prior art assists in determining whether claimed invention involves novelty; statements and remarks in IPRP (Chapter II) as to novelty (see cross-references to industrial applicability and inventive step).

rubrics_metrics.name: Patentability (internationally accepted criteria)
rubrics_metrics.description: Patentability — internationally accepted criteria for patentability.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Patentability generally encompasses novelty, inventive step (non-obviousness) and industrial applicability; matters such as non-prejudicial disclosures and exceptions to lack of novelty are substantive matters of patentability; lack of patentability may be a correctable defect in some circumstances; requirements for patentability identified (see cited rules).

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventive step / Obviousness
rubrics_metrics.description: Inventive step (obviousness) — central substantive criterion for IPE/search.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Inventive step is treated as a distinct IPE criterion (see cross-references); prior art analysis assists assessment of inventive step (see PRIOR ART); see also references to rectification of unity and protests regarding unity which may affect claim scope considered for inventive step.

rubrics_metrics.name: Industrial applicability
rubrics_metrics.description: Industrial applicability — requirement for patentability/assessment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Referenced in connection with novelty and inventive step; see IPRP and written opinion considerations regarding industrial applicability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prior art identification and use
rubrics_metrics.description: Prior art — general rules and role in international search and examination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prior art is used to determine novelty and inventive step; claims must include statement of prior art (see 5.112); prior art relevant for IPE (10.058-10.059); treatment and effect of international applications as prior art in designated States (see national chapter references).

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirements for sequence listings / nucleotide sequence listings
rubrics_metrics.description: Nucleotide sequence listings / sequence listings — format and submission requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See SEQUENCE LISTING references: rules on numbering of electronic medium, numbering of sequence listing part of description; specific guidance at 5.099-5.100, 7.005-7.012, 10.063, 11.088, Annex D; ISR/IPS interaction and requests for sequence listing translations may be required by IPEA.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biological material deposit indications and accession
rubrics_metrics.description: Indication and furnishing of biological material deposit — how and when to reference deposit information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Accessions and dates for biological material deposit referenced (11.078(iii)); dates of furnishing biological material references mentioned in published IA (11.081); separate furnished reference to biological material or deposit included in published IA (11.075); DOs/EOs annexes and Annex L provide more on deposit requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirements for claims (form and content)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for claims — form, content and numbering requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specific requirements for claims cited at 5.112-5.127; numbering of amended claims (9.005); requirements may include statements of prior art (5.112); rectification/amendment rules for claims (5.126, 11.033-11.044) and requirements for Art. 19/34 amendments (9.005, 10.071).

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirements for the description (order and content)
rubrics_metrics.description: Manner and order of description — how the description must be presented.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Order of elements of description referenced (5.094-5.099); requirements for disclosure in the description including biological material disclosure (11.075) and other description requirements (5.094-5.095).

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirements for drawings and figures
rubrics_metrics.description: Drawings — physical/presentation requirements, numbering and when photographs may be used.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presentation of photographs instead of drawing allowed (5.159); figures should be in numbered order in which they appear (5.141-5.142); physical requirements and standards for drawings at 5.128-5.163 and 5.131-5.159; drawings amendments and rectifications references provided (5.161, 11.033-11.038).

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirements for the abstract
rubrics_metrics.description: Abstract — physical and content requirements for the abstract.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Physical requirements for abstract cited at 5.172 and 5.164-5.173; format and content expectations referenced in the Guide.

rubrics_metrics.name: Physical requirements (paper/electronic) for filings
rubrics_metrics.description: Physical requirements by RO and IPEA for papers and electronic media.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Physical requirements for IA regarding paper (5.177) and for specific elements (claims, description, drawings) are cited (5.105, 5.124, 5.131–5.159); IPEA and RO have separate physical requirements (10.044, 10.047(i), 6.001(ii)).

rubrics_metrics.name: Unity of invention
rubrics_metrics.description: Unity of invention — requirement and consequences (unity-related fees and protests).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Unity requirements referenced at 5.114-5.123; protests against additional fees for lack of unity may be made before ISA or IPEA (7.019-7.020, 10.072); ISA may require unity-of-invention additional fee if protest justified; rectification of unity requirement possible (7.015).

rubrics_metrics.name: International Search Report (ISR) standards and timing
rubrics_metrics.description: ISR — content constraints and time limits for establishment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ISR may not contain expression of opinion (7.024); ISR must be established within three months from receipt of the search copy by ISA or priority document (whichever later) (7.023); ISR is published with the published IA (7.025).

rubrics_metrics.name: International Preliminary Examination (IPE) procedures and applicant rights
rubrics_metrics.description: IPE procedures — demand processing, applicant communications, and scope of IPE.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: IPEA checks demand for compliance with form and content (10.044); right of applicant to oral communication with IPEA during IPE (10.067); IPE may be postponed at applicant's request (10.026, 10.052); IPRP (Chapter II) statements and IPEA handling of Art. 34/Art. 19 amendments referenced (10.026, 10.054, 10.071).

rubrics_metrics.name: Request form and filing boxes (formal filing requirements)
rubrics_metrics.description: Request form — required boxes and what information each box must contain.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Detailed guidance for Request Form: Box I Title of Invention (5.019); Boxes II/III Applicants/Inventors (5.020-5.039); Box IV Agent/Common Representative/Address for Correspondence (5.041-5.051); Box V Designation of States (5.052-5.055); Box VI Priority Claim (5.057-5.071); Box VII ISA (5.072-5.073); Box VIII Declarations (5.074-5.083); Box IX Check List/Language (5.084-5.087); Box X Signature (5.088-5.091). Continuation sheets, supplemental boxes and fee calculation sheet guidance provided (5.085, 5.093).

rubrics_metrics.name: Power of attorney and representation requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Power of attorney / Representation — when a power is required and registration of agents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Text of power of attorney and related guidance (4.001-4.026, 1.005); power required if agent signs IA (5.089); registration of agent with RO (5.043); recording, revocation and renunciation of appointment of agent/common representative (11.001-11.014; 11.014 for manner of renunciation); requirements for powers of attorney and submission procedures (11.008).

rubrics_metrics.name: Recording of changes (applicant/agent/inventor)
rubrics_metrics.description: Recording changes such as appointment of agents, death of applicant/inventor, or successor indication.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recording of change entries: appointment of agents (11.001); check list changes (11.018-11.022); in case of death of applicant/inventor (11.023-11.026); recording of replacements and amendments in demand/request (10.030, 5.084-5.087).

rubrics_metrics.name: Rectification and correction of errors (obvious mistakes)
rubrics_metrics.description: Rectification of obvious mistakes and other corrections to the IA, IS, SIS and IPE material.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rectification of obvious mistakes in IA generally (11.033-11.044); authorization and effect of rectification (11.038-11.044); rectification of IS (7.003), SIS (8.002) and unity requirement (7.015); applicant-initiated rectifications and where requests must be sent (11.033-11.034).

rubrics_metrics.name: Time limits, priority periods and deadlines
rubrics_metrics.description: Time limits for various PCT acts — priority periods, deadlines for demands, publication timing and national phase entry.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specific periods referenced: 13, 16, 17, 18, 19, 20, 26, 28, 30 months from priority/filing for various actions (e.g., demand filing, availability of Art. 19/34 amendments, establishment of IPRP Chapter II, national/regional fees deadlines). Priority date established by priority claim (5.060); national/regional phase entry deadlines extended by IPE for certain DOs (10.002).

rubrics_metrics.name: Fees, payments, refunds and reductions
rubrics_metrics.description: Fee handling — payments, refunds, reductions and handling of fee-related protests.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refunds of international/search/handling/IPE fees where IA withdrawn before transmittal of record or search copy (5.197); refund sent by telecommunication should be followed by original (11.068); ISA refund/fee adjustments for partial searches and unity protests (7.017-7.019, 5.198); third parties must reimburse IB for priority document copies furnished after publication (9.023).

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication and published international application content
rubrics_metrics.description: International publication — what is published and how publication is effected.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Published IA includes front page information (9.020), English translations of title/abstract/ISR included (9.017); ISR published with the published IA (7.025); access to published IA and obtaining copies (9.021); declarations under Rule 4.17(v) published as part of the published IA (5.077, 6.050).

rubrics_metrics.name: Record copy transmission, receipt and national security exceptions
rubrics_metrics.description: Record copy of IA — transmission to IB, receipt monitoring, and circumstances where transmission is withheld for national security.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Record copy considered true copy of IA (6.057); must reach IB within prescribed time limit (6.057); RO has right not to transmit record copy to IB for national security (6.010); notification to applicant, ISA, RO and DO of receipt of record copy (9.002-9.003).

rubrics_metrics.name: Replacement sheets and format for amendments
rubrics_metrics.description: Replacement sheets — use as form for corrections and for annexing amendments/rectifications to IPRP.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Replacement sheets as a form for correction (6.052); replacement sheets containing amendments annexed to IPRP (Chapter II) (10.076); must be accompanied by a letter (6.052, 9.005-9.006); agents/common representatives may file replacement sheets before various authorities (10.019-10.023, 5.034, 5.041-5.048).

rubrics_metrics.name: Markush practice / technical interrelationship
rubrics_metrics.description: Markush practice — requirement for technical interrelationship among alternatives in Markush-type claims.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requirements of technical interrelationship (Markush Practice) are covered (5.118) and affect unity/claim acceptability; related practice and national differences referenced.

rubrics_metrics.name: Right to file: nationality and residence requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Right to file an IA/demand — residence/nationality conditions that must be met.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For IA filing, one applicant must be resident or national of a Contracting State (5.020); for demand filing (Chapter II) one applicant must be resident or national of a Contracting State bound by Chapter II (10.004, 10.017); corrections of residence/nationality indications and effects on right to file documented (6.036, 10.046).

rubrics_metrics.name: Protests and appeals (unity protests, review of RO decisions)
rubrics_metrics.description: Protests and review procedures — how to protest ISA/IPEA actions and request review of RO decisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Protests against payment of additional unity fees before ISA (7.019-7.020) and IPEA (10.072); review by DO of RO decision and petition procedures (6.054-6.056); refusal/decision revision processes referenced.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedures for IS, IPE, ISA, RO, IB processing
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedural standards for how IA is processed by IB, ISA, RO and IPEA.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Processing of IA by IB (9.001-9.029), by ISA (7.001-7.032), by RO (6.001) and of demand (10.044-10.050) described; “telescoped” procedures (overlapping IS and IPE) referenced (10.052); supplementary international search request processing by IB (8.038).

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication prevention and provisional protection conditions
rubrics_metrics.description: Prevention of international publication and conditions affecting provisional protection.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prevention of international publication (9.023A, 11.049) and prevention of transmittal of record copy for national security reasons (6.010-6.011, 6.058); provisional protection may be made conditional on furnishing a translation on expiration of period (9.024).
